text: Visitor reviews over the last 30 days indicate issues with the food quality and menu options at the Theodore Roosevelt Presidential Library. Several visitors found the salads either lacking flavor or having unusual combinations, and one noted the venison chili was bland. There were also complaints about the limited menu range and the absence of cups for water, which affected the overall service experience. Additionally, one review mentioned that the food was overpriced given the portion sizes. These points suggest a need to review and improve the food offerings and service amenities.

windows.60: Recent visitor reviews indicate that the food quality at the Theodore Roosevelt Presidential Library needs improvement, with several comments describing salads as bland or having awkward flavor combinations and the venison chili as lacking seasoning. Some guests also found the food overpriced and portions minimal. Service issues were noted, including the refusal to provide cups for water. Wait times were mentioned in multiple reviews, suggesting delays that may affect visitor experience. Overall, the average rating is just above 3, reflecting mixed feedback with more critical than positive comments.
windows.90: Visitor reviews over the last 90 days indicate ongoing issues with the food service at the Theodore Roosevelt Presidential Library. Several guests found the menu limited and the food quality inconsistent, with specific complaints about bland or poorly prepared dishes and a lack of variety. Wait times and service problems were also noted, including delays and temporary closures of the kitchen during visits. Some reviewers mentioned concerns about value, feeling the food was overpriced for what was offered. Attention to menu options, food preparation, and service efficiency would likely improve visitor satisfaction.
